notes: re-scoped from the shared unit to sysml alone (ADR-0015)
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.17.4. The clause and the Xtext state this production identically — `OccurrenceUsagePrefix AcceptNodeDeclaration ActionBody` in both (SysML.xtext:1442) — so there is nothing to weigh. All three parts are mandatory; the optionality lives one level down, in AcceptNodeDeclaration's `ActionNodeUsageDeclaration?`, which is what lets an accept node be written with or without the 'action' keyword and a name.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription. The pack flags this clause as malformed, but the defect is in TriggerExpression (SYSML21-401) and not in this production.

Inside `action a1 {` on line 14: line 17 `then accept S;` is an accept node with an empty OccurrenceUsagePrefix and `;` as the ActionBody. Line 18 `then accept sig after 10[SI::s];` and line 22 `then accept when b.f;` are the same production with trigger expressions.
Second opinion. Identical to the clause.
